title: Zero weak derivatives against smooth tests extend to C¹ tests (mollification)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, D ⊆ ℝⁿ open, G : ℝⁿ → ℝ locally integrable on D (LocallyIntegrableOn G D), and suppose ∫_D G(v)·∂ⱼa(v) dv = 0 for every a ∈ C^∞(ℝⁿ) with compact support and tsupport a ⊆ D and every j ∈ Fin n (∂ⱼa(v) := Da(v)eⱼ). Then ∫_{ℝⁿ} G(x)·∂ᵢφ(x) dx = 0 for every C¹ function φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ with compact support and tsupport φ ⊆ D and every i ∈ Fin n (eᵢ = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ i).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid n)) (G : Euclid n → ℝ), IsOpen D → LocallyIntegrableOn G D volume → (∀ a : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ D → ∀ j : Fin n, ∫ v in D, G v * fderiv ℝ a v (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) = 0) → ∀ φ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∀ i : Fin n, ∫ x, G x * fderiv ℝ φ x ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) i) = 0
